MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

David M. Helbraun, Esq. appeared with plaintiff Bruce V.A. Bonacker, dba Bonacker Associates, who was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendant Terry Brown.
Default entered against defendant on July 17, 2008.
Doe defendants were dismissed on June 2, 2008.
Defendant Owners of 607 Belvedere Street, San Francisco was dismissed on November 28, 2007.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of plaintiff Bruce V.A. Bonacker, dba Bonacker Associates, and against the Defaulted Defendant Terry Brown as follows:

Damages/Principal - $16,794.12.
Prejudgment Interest - $9,082.79.
Costs - $456.50, for a total of $26,303.41.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
